name: Real Estate Photoshoot
description: Professional real estate photography project from initial contact to final delivery, including travel, on-site capture (up to 2 hrs), options selection, post-editing, and social media publishing.

children.name: Initial client enquiry
children.description: Receive enquiry, discuss property type and client needs

children.name: Quote & options selection
children.description: Send quote with options: photography, video, drone, 3D, floor plan, twilight

children.name: Booking confirmation
children.description: Confirm booking, receive deposit, schedule shoot date

children.name: Equipment preparation
children.description: Check cameras, lenses, drone, lighting, batteries, memory cards

children.name: Location planning
children.description: Check route, estimate travel time, confirm access arrangements

children.name: Weather check
children.description: Monitor weather forecast, confirm shoot conditions

tasks.name: Travel to Property
tasks.description: Travel to property location (allow 30-60 min each way)

tasks.name: On-Site Photography
tasks.description: On-site shoot (up to 2 hours depending on property size and options)

children.name: Exterior photography
children.description: Front façade, rear, sides, landscaping, architectural details

children.name: Interior photography
children.description: All rooms, wide angles, detail shots, ambient lighting

children.name: Drone/aerial photography
children.description: Aerial property shots, neighborhood context (if option selected)

children.name: Video walkthrough
children.description: Cinematic property walkthrough video (if option selected)

children.name: 3D scan / Matterport
children.description: 3D virtual tour capture (if option selected)

children.name: Floor plan capture
children.description: Measure and capture data for floor plan (if option selected)

tasks.name: Twilight Photography
tasks.description: Return for twilight exterior shots (if option selected, seasonal timing)

children.name: Photo culling & selection
children.description: Cull and select best shots from all captures

children.name: HDR processing & color correction
children.description: HDR blending, exposure correction, white balance

children.name: Retouching & enhancements
children.description: Sky replacement, staging cleanup, verticals correction

children.name: Final export (print + web)
children.description: Export high-res for print and optimized web versions

tasks.name: Video & Drone Editing
tasks.description: Video editing, color grading, stabilization (if video/drone options selected)

tasks.name: 3D & Floor Plan Production
tasks.description: Process 3D scan, create floor plan (if options selected)

children.name: Create proof gallery
children.description: Upload to online proof gallery for client review

children.name: Client feedback period
children.description: Allow time for client to review and request edits

children.name: Revision round
children.description: Complete client-requested revisions

children.name: Marketing materials
children.description: Create flyers, brochures, listing cards (if required)

children.name: Social media assets
children.description: Create Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn posts and stories

children.name: Schedule social posts
children.description: Schedule posts across platforms using social media tools

children.name: Publish to social channels
children.description: Publish posts to Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok

children.name: Upload to MLS & portals
children.description: Upload final images to MLS, realtor.com, client portal

children.name: Client file delivery
children.description: Deliver final files via download link

children.name: Project archiving
children.description: Archive raw files and project assets

risks.title: Weather cancellation
risks.mitigationPlan: Schedule backup shoot day, monitor weather 48hrs ahead, have indoor-only contingency shots

risks.title: Drone flight restrictions
risks.mitigationPlan: Check airspace via LAANC 7 days prior, verify no temporary restrictions, have ground-only backup

risks.title: Equipment failure on-site
risks.mitigationPlan: Carry backup camera body, 2+ lenses, 6+ batteries, 4+ memory cards, backup drone

risks.title: Property not photo-ready
risks.mitigationPlan: Confirm staging 24hrs before, provide prep checklist to agent, have stager on standby

risks.title: Client scope creep
risks.mitigationPlan: Detailed contract with shot list, fixed revision rounds, hourly rate for extras

risks.title: Traffic/travel delays
risks.mitigationPlan: Allow 50% extra travel time for shoots, schedule buffer between jobs, check traffic apps

risks.title: Access issues at property
risks.mitigationPlan: Confirm lockbox/code 24hrs prior, have agent contact number, verify parking

risks.title: Social media algorithm changes
risks.mitigationPlan: Diversify platforms, focus on engagement metrics, maintain content calendar
